name: Television outlet plan symbol
summary: Plan symbol for a television or cable TV outlet with a coaxial connection.
description: Television outlets terminate the building TV distribution, whether from terrestrial antenna, satellite or a cable TV provider. Plans draw a triangle or outlet shape tagged TV, sometimes with an additional tag for satellite (SAT) or FM.

The plan symbol tells the installer to run a coaxial cable from the distribution amplifier or splitter, and to provide a power outlet nearby for the television. Multi-dwelling buildings use outlets with defined isolation and signal levels. It does not show the signal sources or the loss budget; the TV distribution design does.
readingNotes: Look for SAT or FM tags.
Find the source amplifier or splitter.
distinction: A data outlet carries network cabling; a TV outlet carries coaxial RF signals.
